description: This file defines a class VTEntityType that manages entity type information, such as retrieving tab IDs, module names, field names, and field types from the database for a specific entity type. It also includes a VTFieldType class for representing field type details.

classes.name: VTEntityType
classes.description: Provides methods to manage and retrieve information about entity types, including fetching field names and types.

classes.name: VTFieldType
classes.description: Represents the type of a field, with a method to convert its properties to an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance with database connection, module name, and tab ID.

methods.name: getTabId
methods.description: Returns the tab ID associated with the entity type.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the entity type.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Retrieves all field names for the entity type.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves the field type information for a given field name.

methods.name: getFieldTypes
methods.description: Retrieves types for all fields associated with the entity type.
